paper_title: g-C₃N₄-based smart nanocatalysts for photocatalytic cancer therapy

questions.question: How do different g-C₃N₄-based nanocatalysts differ in material composition, structural design, and photocatalytic mechanisms, and what evidence does the paper provide for comparison?
What experimental evidence is discussed to evaluate the photocatalytic performance and anticancer effects of g-C₃N₄-based nanocatalysts, and what conclusions can each type of evidence support?

How do illumination conditions, material properties, and reactive oxygen species generation affect the therapeutic efficacy of g-C₃N₄-based nanocatalysts against cancer cells, and what evidence supports these relationships?
What are the potential advantages and limitations of g-C₃N₄-based smart nanocatalysts regarding biocompatibility, selectivity, therapeutic safety, and clinical translation?
What technical challenges and research gaps remain in g-C₃N₄-based photocatalytic cancer therapy, and what future research directions are discussed in the paper?
